<function name="GetManipulateBoneJiggle" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the jiggle amount of the entity's bone.

See <page>Entity:ManipulateBoneJiggle</page> for more info.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="boneID" type="number">The bone ID</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The jiggle bone type, as set by <page>Entity:ManipulateBoneJiggle</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
